name: Annual self-certification of Headers and templates (r. 22(1)(c))

attrs.quote: develop a mechanism for the registered Senders and RTMs to self-certify annually
attrs.scope: registered Senders and RTMs, through their Access Providers
attrs.note: A Sender or RTM that does not certify its registration details, Headers, Content Templates and Consent Templates is suspended automatically, or the uncertified items are.
